scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate colorblind-safe palette and swarm+boxplot composite show real design intent, but the subtitle text collides with the percentile labels at the top, and the rightmost callout (Sam Q.) is clipped at the canvas edge — concrete layout bugs that cap the score.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate for skewed income data, box plot statistics and percentiles are data-driven, and no radius/baseline deception apply to dot plots, but the xScale domain is hardcoded ([14000, 550000]) rather than derived from d3.extent, making it brittle to data shifts.
scores.stress_test_note: Fully static pre-computed simulation with unified pointer-events tooltip (no brush, zoom, transitions, or cross-view dispatch) — no meaningful interaction robustness hazards present.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view swarm with only 4 colorblind-safe categories, pre-computed force (no runtime animation), and a clear marginal box plot keeps cognitive load low; minor readability hit from subtitle text colliding with the P25/P50 labels and five callout lines crowding the right tail.

proposer: 224 lines. Replaced `.each()` callback with pre-computed properties + idiomatic D3 separate appends, and inlined the legend container variable.
